cards.text: David is on the run from Saul, king of Israel. He just got away from Achish, king of Gath, by pretending to be insane (1 Samuel 21:10-15). Now David leaves Gath, and he needs somewhere to hide.

cards.question: After leaving Gath, David takes refuge in the ___ of Adullam.
David's brothers and the rest of his father's household hear that he's hiding at the cave of Adullam. What do they do?

cards.text: Then everyone who's distressed or in debt or discontented rallies around David too. Stressed, broke and fed up? Friend, that was me and the dead batteries I shared a junk drawer with.

cards.question: The distressed, the indebted and the discontented rally around David, and he becomes their ___.

cards.text: About four hundred men are with David now. From there he goes to Mizpeh of Moab, with a favor to ask the king of Moab.

cards.question: David asks the king of Moab to let his father and mother stay with him until David learns what ___ will do for him.

cards.text: David's parents stay with the king of Moab the whole time David is in the stronghold. Then Gad, a prophet, has something to tell David.

cards.question: What does the prophet Gad tell David?

answers.text: Leave the stronghold and go into Judah
Stay in the stronghold and wait there
Go back to Achish in the city of Gath

cards.text: So David leaves and goes to the forest of Hereth. Soon Saul learns that David and his men have been discovered.
Saul is sitting under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, spear in hand, all his servants standing around him. When the boss brings a spear to the team meeting, nobody asks about vacation days.

cards.question: Saul asks his men of Benjamin if David is giving them fields and vineyards and making them commanders. What does Saul accuse them all of?

cards.text: Saul says not one of them told him his own son made a covenant with David, and not one of them has shown concern for him. You know when you post in the group chat and get ZERO replies?
Then Doeg the Edomite speaks up. He's Saul's chief shepherd (1 Samuel 21:7), and he's got a report for the king.

cards.question: What does Doeg tell Saul he saw?

answers.text: David come to Ahimelech at Nob
David meet Jonathan in the field

cards.question: Doeg tells Saul that Ahimelech sent David away with nothing.

cards.text: Saul sends messengers to summon Ahimelech the priest, son of Ahitub, and his father's whole family, the priests at Nob, and all of them come. When a king with a spear in his hand sends for your WHOLE family, nobody's replying "maybe" to that invite.
"Listen now, son of Ahitub," Saul says. "Here I am, my lord," Ahimelech replies.

cards.question: Saul accuses Ahimelech of giving David bread and a sword and inquiring of God for him. What does Saul say that was for?

answers.text: So David could rise up against him
So David could make peace with him
So David could fight the Philistines

cards.question: Ahimelech tells Saul that none of the king's servants is as faithful as David.

cards.text: Ahimelech basically reads David's résumé to King Saul: the king's son-in-law, captain of his bodyguard, honored in his house. Then he asks, "Was that day the first time I inquired of God for him?"

cards.question: Ahimelech pleads with the king and says he knew ___ of this whole affair.
After hearing Ahimelech out, Saul spares him and his father's house.

cards.text: Saul orders the guards at his side to kill the priests of the LORD. His reason: they sided with David, they knew he was fleeing, and they didn't tell him.

cards.question: Saul's guards obey him and strike down the priests of the LORD.

cards.text: So Saul gives the order to Doeg the Edomite, and Doeg turns and strikes down the priests himself. That day he kills eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.

Doeg also puts Nob, the city of the priests, to the sword, with its men and women, children and infants, oxen, donkeys and sheep. I think this one hurts, friend, and it's okay to feel the weight of it.

cards.question: But one of Ahimelech's sons, Abiathar, escapes and flees to ___.

cards.text: Abiathar tells David that Saul has killed the priests of the LORD. And David has something to say about that day at Nob.

cards.question: What does David tell Abiathar he knew that day at Nob?

answers.text: Doeg was there and was sure to tell Saul
Saul's guards were watching the road
Achish was waiting for him in Gath

cards.question: David tells Abiathar that he himself is ___ for the lives of everyone in Abiathar's father's house.
David has one more thing to tell Abiathar. What does he tell him to do?

answers.text: Stay with him and not be afraid
Hide in Moab with David's parents

cards.text: David tells him that whoever is after Abiathar's life is after his too, and that Abiathar will be safe with him. Two men on the run, sticking together, and trust me, friend, this story is FAR from over.
